## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure cases.
- [ ] Public documentation is updated when behavior, configuration, or commands change.
- [ ] No secrets, visitor cookies, user data, database dumps, or raw invitation/owner-claim URLs are included.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, license-compatible, and reflected in both package files.
- [ ] I understand and take responsibility for all submitted code, including AI-assisted code.
